title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 72
description: Ten questions on Psalms 72: a prayer for the king - justice for the poor, rule from sea to sea, and a name that endures forever.

questions.text: To whom does the speaker ask God to give his justice?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son."

questions.text: Like what will he come down, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says he will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

answers.text: Like rain on the mown grass

questions.text: According to verse 8, from where to where shall he have dominion?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he shall have dominion from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

answers.text: From the mountains to the valleys

questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "His enemies shall lick the dust."

questions.text: Which kings will bring tribute, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute.

answers.text: The kings of Egypt and Assyria
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands
The kings of Moab and Edom
The kings of Babylon and Persia

questions.text: What will be precious in his sight?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says he will redeem their soul from oppression and violence, and their blood will be precious in his sight.

questions.text: What shall be given to him, according to verse 15?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says: "To him shall be given of the gold of Sheba."

questions.text: Like what does the fruit sway in verse 16?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says abundance of grain shall be throughout the land, and its fruit sways like Lebanon.

questions.text: How long does his name continue, according to verse 17?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says: "His name continues as long as the sun."

questions.text: According to verse 20, whose prayers end here?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says: "This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse."
